name: PC Power Meter Lite
description:
PC Power Meter Lite turns one power sensor already exposed by iCUE into an electricity meter for your XENEON Edge.

See current watts, a wide rolling power graph, session average, session peak and session energy in Wh or kWh. Session energy is integrated from real samples using their actual elapsed time, so the calculation does not assume a perfect one second sample interval.

Choose the power sensor directly with iCUE's native sensor selector. The meter names the selected source and describes its measured scope using provider metadata. CPU package power stays CPU package power. PSU input and output stay PSU input and output. A true total power draw label is used only when iCUE exposes that scope.

Missing, disconnected or invalid intervals are never filled with guessed power. Session totals can survive a short widget restart, but the offline gap is not integrated.

The rolling graph is designed for the unusually wide XENEON Edge display, with deliberate layouts for all eight official size and orientation combinations.

An optional information panel explains exactly what is measured and includes a quiet link to PC Power Meter Pro on the Elgato Marketplace. The main dashboard contains no upgrade nag.

No account, helper app or external service is required.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for Corsair XENEON Edge.
release_notes: Updated the Lite edition to use the verified direct Pro Marketplace listing and refreshed package validation.
